description.value: Tractor Foods is a scratch-made fast-casual chain with eight locations across Vancouver and Victoria, known for its plant-forward bowls, soups, sandwiches, and fresh breakfast options. The Pender Street location (Unit 102B) serves the downtown core and offers both walk-in and pre-order pickup. A touring cyclist heading through downtown Vancouver will find a filling, health-oriented meal with quick turnaround.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 36m; stands (3 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 69m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 83m; stands (6 spaces) at 96m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active multi-location chain with a specific listing for '700 West Pender St. Unit 102B' (Tractor Foods Pender), matching the OSM address. Takeout (pickup) is explicitly described on the website; the catering page uses 'Plant-Forward' and the menu lists salads, power greens, and veggie-forward items, supporting a vegetarian/vegan claim.
